verdict.rationale: The pricing page documents per-plan monthly search quotas: Free at 250 searches/month, and a Cloud 1M tier at $3,750/mo with 1,000,000 searches. It also states a self-serve path ("Start for free, upgrade as you grow") plus Automatic Early Renewal when searches run out. However, the Cloud 1M row's second figure (110,000) appears without a column label, so it cannot be read as a documented rate limit, and no concurrency caps are documented. missing for 10: explicitly labeled per-hour/per-second rate limits, documented concurrency caps, rate-limit error/header behavior, independent corroboration of the upgrade flow.
